(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター サン・ムーン編''' ''Pocket Monsters Sun Moon'') is a {{wp|shōnen}} [[Pokémon manga]] created by 穴久保幸作 [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. It is follow-up to the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters XY|Kosaku Anakubo}} series, following the legacy of sequels to the original [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] series. The plot follows the adventures of {{PPM|Red}} and his Pokémon as they travel to the [[Alola]] region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.

This was the final entry in the Pokémon Pocket Monsters series to be published in CoroCoro Magazine, ending in October 2019 and replaced by a manga adaption of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' the following month. Its sequel – [[Pocket Monsters Aniki]] – is henceforth published in CoroCoro Special and CoroCoro Aniki.
